# ORITOKI (ორითოკი)

> ORITOKI (legal name: oritoki LLC / შპს ორითოკი, ID 402372918) is an industrial rope access and works-at-height company in Tbilisi, Georgia. It works where scaffolding, cranes or other traditional access methods are impractical or impossible, following IRATA rope-access standards. Team members hold IRATA, SPRAT and IFMGA Rope Access certifications and have over 15 years of experience.

- Website: https://oritoki.ge/ (Georgian) · https://oritoki.ge/en (English)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +995 598 42 80 22
- E-mail: info@oritoki.ge
- Address: 13 E. Ninoshvili St., Apt 23B, Tbilisi, Georgia
- Service area: Georgia
- Free consultation and quote on request.
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61591512283062

## Services

- Glass facades & windows: window cleaning, glass facade cleaning, glass installation and removal, replacement of damaged glass, silicone replacement and sealing, structures install and dismantle.
- Building maintenance: technical maintenance, repairs and preventive inspection; rainwater systems (gutters, pipes); ventilation systems; facade element repair; facade cleaning and washing; thermal insulation and waterproofing.
- Electrical & telecom: lighting and floodlights; air-conditioner outdoor units; antennas and telecom equipment; lightning protection; security systems, cameras and sensors; cables and cable trays; solar panels.
- Advertising & signage: banners, billboards and advertising structures; signs and LED signs; flags.
- Painting & protection: treatment and painting of facades and metal structures; anti-corrosion works; protective coatings.
- Construction & insulation: concrete and crack repair; stone and brickwork restoration; facade and historical monument restoration; metal structures; facade sealing.
- Rock, slope & environment: rock-mesh reinforcement and stabilization; rockfall removal; rock inspection and cleaning; tree pruning and hazardous-branch removal.
- Industrial facilities: tank and silo inspection and cleaning; chimney inspection and repair; factory maintenance; wind-turbine inspection and repair; pipeline installation.
- Inspection: structural diagnostics, ultrasonic and visual inspection; insulation system inspection; safety-system inspection.
- Stage & filming: technical support for film, series and commercial shoots; stage structures and lighting; rigging; moving structures and decorations.
- Special & emergency works: rescue operations; safe removal, lifting and lowering of objects; access to hard-to-reach locations; emergency works; custom works-at-height solutions.
